slides.headline: Transcribe speech four times faster
slides.say: This GitHub project has been around since 2023, and it lets you transcribe speech to text up to four times faster.

slides.headline: Rewrites Whisper for speed
slides.body: Uses CTranslate2 engine for up to four times faster transcription with less memory.
slides.say: This tool rewrites Whisper with a faster engine, giving you speech-to-text up to four times quicker.

slides.headline: 26,976 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Python · Since February 2023
slides.say: It has over 20 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence.

slides.headline: GPU needs NVIDIA libraries
slides.body: CUDA 12 and cuDNN 9 required for GPU; check README and licence before installing.
slides.say: GPU needs specific NVIDIA libraries; check the README and licence first.
